sufficiency_witness: Three 1987 names are obsolete combinations whose species now sit in other genera (taxonomy.csv); the genus must come from the current name.
analysis_specification: Map each recorded name to its current_name in taxonomy.csv; the genus is the first word of the current name. Sum counts per genus; mean Bray–Curtis on raw genus counts over all sample pairs; report it and the number of genera with a nonzero total.
